maria: quick sync 1: new q4b-int8 bring-up for model-x shows a regression on our longform prompt bank (multi-paragraph QAs). fp32 baseline vs q4b-int8 EM delta ~12% on golden subset :grimacing:

kai: ouch. which fidelity metric is spiking? hallucination or just answer mismatch?

maria: mainly hallucination and span-shift due to punctuation normalization. i opened a staging PR with a lightweight normalizer (PR #1189) to align tokenization.

ash: also noticed dedupe noise. our current fingerprint dedupe (jaccard>0.6) is conflating paraphrases; that could be inflating the golden variance. propose semantic dedupe at cosine>0.88 to surface near-paraphrases.

ash: kicked off semantic pass against staging samplebank -> golden, collecting top-400 ambiguous pairs. query used:

```sql
-- ambiguous pair seed
SELECT s.id AS sample_id, g.id AS golden_id, cosine_similarity(s.embed, g.embed) AS sim
FROM staging.samplebank s
JOIN golden.set g ON TRUE
WHERE cosine_similarity(s.embed, g.embed) > 0.88
AND cosine_similarity(s.embed, g.embed) < 0.995
ORDER BY sim DESC
LIMIT 400;
```

ash: exported CSV and created label job LAB-1768. labelops_bot: "job LAB-1768 created, assignees: sam, toni, 3 contractors, ETA 72h"

labelops_bot: job LAB-1768 status: queued -> in_progress

sam: pulling first 80 now. will focus on multi-paragraph QA + code examples. how should we tag edge cases?

maria: relabelers mark: (A) exact-match changed, (B) hallucinated extra facts, (C) tokenization-induced span shift, (D) ambiguous/generic. tag each with #quant4b-holdout so we can filter in the eval harness.

kai: after relabel, i'll run two bench passes: fp32 baseline and q4b-int8 with identical seeds/beams. metrics to capture: latency, EM, F1, hallucination-rate (annotator flag), and tokenization-shift-count. if EM delta < 1.5% and hallucination drops, we can try a 5% canary. otherwise we either tighten quant profile or skip rollout.
toni: quick note 1: i noticed some golden QA pairs were authored from forum scraping and include extraneous context. should we prune those from golden and move to holdout?

maria: yes move forum-sourced noisy pairs to holdout. we'll expand the golden with 200 vetted human-authored pairs to keep coverage.

ash: semantic pass completed at 1768008034, produced 400 candidate ambiguous items. uploaded to LAB-1768 queue. labelops_bot: "100/400 completed (25%)"

sam: first batch in. a few tricky ones where the short answer matches but explanatory sentences differ. tagging those as (D) ambiguous.

kai: once relabel CSV is ready ping me. planning to snapshot bench runs under qbench snapshot: qbench://snap/1768008001-q4b-holdout-check

maria: also added console alert "quant4b-golden-regress" with threshold EM delta 2% and webhook to #eng-runtime. ash/nash confirm?

ash: confirmed alert + webhook configured.

labelops_bot: LAB-1768 update: 200/400 completed (50%).
